item.title: Huha Wear: $20 MIllion Raised For Apparel Brand
item.description: District Ventures Capital has made its largest investment to date by leading a $20 million financing round in Vancouver based women’s intimate apparel brand Huha Wear Inc. The deal is also the largest investment in the 20 year history of the television series Dragons' Den, following the original pitch made by Huha’s founder, Alexa Suter, on Season 18.

item.title: J.C. Flowers To Sell Island Finance To VRM Penzini Capital In Major Puerto Rico Acquisition
item.description: J.C. Flowers has reached an agreement to sell Island Finance, Puerto Rico’s largest non-bank consumer financial institution, to VRM Penzini Capital. The deal marks one of the most notable financial services transactions in Puerto Rico this year and is expected to close in December 2025. Financial terms were not disclosed.

item.title: Merit Financial Advisors: $1.2 Billion Firm Blueprint Wealth Onboarded
item.description: Merit Financial Advisors has completed the acquisition of Blueprint Wealth Advisors, a strategic transaction that strengthens Merit's presence across the Midwest and brings $1.2 billion in additional assets under management. The deal expands Merit's reach across Illinois and Wisconsin, introduces the firm to the Chicago market, and adds a high-performing team recognized for serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.

item.title: Sorcero: $42.5 Million Series B Raised To Advance Expansion Of Its Life Sciences AI Platform
item.description: Sorcero has secured $42.5 million in Series B financing led by NewSpring Growth, with participation from Leawood Venture Capital and Blu Ventures, bringing the company’s total capital raised to $59 million. The new funding will support rapid expansion across medical affairs, safety, scientific communications, and medical device markets, while scaling its AI platform designed to help life sciences organizations drive adoption of advanced therapies.

item.title: Tidalwave: $22 Million Series A Secured To Advance Agentic AI Mortgage Platform And Expand Market Share
item.description: Tidalwave, a New York-based agentic AI mortgage point-of-sale platform, has raised a $22 million Series A round led by Permanent Capital, with participation from D.R. Horton (the largest homebuilder in the United States), and follow-on funding from Engineering Capital. The round brings the company’s total capital raised to $24 million. And it marks a significant new enterprise relationship, as D.R. Horton is investing as both a strategic partner and a new enterprise customer.

item.title: OpenAI And Foxconn Launch Collaboration To Advance U.S. Manufacturing For Next-Generation AI Infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI and Hon Hai Technology Group, known globally as Foxconn, announced a new collaboration to accelerate the design and domestic manufacturing readiness of next-generation AI infrastructure hardware in the United States. The partnership will provide Foxconn with insight into OpenAI’s emerging hardware needs across the fast-growing AI sector, guiding the company’s design and development efforts for systems to be produced in its U.S. facilities. item.title: Aeris: Strategic Investment Secured From TA Associates To Accelerate Global IoT Expansion
item.description: Aeris, a long-established provider of SaaS-based IoT connectivity solutions, announced that TA Associates has made a strategic minority investment in the company. The funding marks a significant moment for Aeris as it aims to expand its global footprint and advance its portfolio of enterprise-grade IoT technologies. Financial terms were not disclosed.

item.title: Harbour Group Expands Specialty Chemicals Portfolio With Acquisition Of Fusion Chemical
item.description: Americo Chemical Products, a portfolio company of St. Louis-based Harbour Group, has acquired Indiana-based Fusion Chemical, marking a strategic expansion in the specialty metalworking fluids sector. The transaction enhances Americo’s product line with next-generation lubricants and coolants while bringing Fusion’s founder, Matt East, and his team into the organization. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

item.title: Worldwide Diversified Buys Controlling Stake In American Lithium Minerals To Advance Global Rare Earth And Mineral Strategy
item.description: American Lithium Minerals, Inc. announced that Worldwide Diversified Holdings, Inc. has acquired a controlling interest in the company, initiating a major strategic shift intended to position AMLM as a global leader in the development of minerals and rare earth assets. The acquisition includes indirect control over AMLM’s option on a 1,730-acre lithium and boron property in Nevada, which will serve as the foundation of a broader international expansion strategy.

item.title: Pelican Energy Partners Acquires Hanna Cylinders To Expand Nuclear And Industrial Manufacturing Platform
item.description: Pelican Energy Partners has acquired Wisconsin-based Hanna Cylinders, strengthening its portfolio of specialized manufacturing companies serving the nuclear and broader industrial markets. The transaction provides Pelican with a new strategic platform to support critical domestic supply chains for high-performance hydraulic and pneumatic equipment used across energy, infrastructure, and heavy industrial applications.
